title: Spatial Postpositions: Boundaries, Lines, and Proximity

sections.title: Delineating Boundaries: innen and túl
sections.content: In Hungarian geographic and cultural discourse, boundaries are framed using the postpositions 'innen' ('on this side of') and 'túl' ('beyond / on the other side of'). Both follow superessive case (-on/-en/-ön) or bare nouns with adpositional force: 'a Dunán innen és túl' ('on this and that side of the Danube'), 'a határon túl' ('beyond the border'), 'az Alpokon túl' ('beyond the Alps'). Figuratively, they express epistemological boundaries: 'a józan ész határain túl' ('beyond the bounds of common sense').

sections.title: Linear Alignment and Spatial Zones: mentén and táján
sections.content: 'Mentén' ('along') governs a bare nominative noun to describe motion or distribution extending parallel to a landmark: 'a Tisza mentén' ('along the Tisza river'), 'a vasútvonal mentén' ('along the railway line'). 'Táján' ('in the vicinity of / around') denotes an approximate spatial perimeter: 'a Balaton táján' ('around Lake Balaton'), 'a falu táján' ('in the environs of the village'). Unlike indoor spatial postpositions, these belong to broader regional descriptions.

items.spanish: A Dunán innen dombos lankák, a Dunán túl végtelen síkságok terülnek el.
items.english: On this side of the Danube rolling hills, beyond the Danube endless plains stretch out.

items.spanish: A kutatók a határvidék mentén gyűjtötték a helyi népdalokat és mondákat.
items.english: The researchers collected local folk songs and legends along the borderland.

items.spanish: A Tisza táján évszázadokon át a folyó áradásai határozták meg az élet ritmusát.
items.english: In the environs of the Tisza, for centuries the river's floods determined the rhythm of life.

items.spanish: A látóhatáron túl felsejlő tanyák lakói ritkán látogattak el a városba.
items.english: Residents of the homesteads looming beyond the horizon rarely visited the town.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Remember that 'innen' and 'túl' require the superessive suffix (-on/-en/-ön) on the noun: 'a Dunán innen', 'a hegyen túl'. By contrast, 'mentén' and 'táján' follow the bare noun: 'a part mentén', 'a város táján'.
